title: Example role
summary: A sample role directory: copy its shape, not its name, when creating a custom role.
shapes: example work: replace this line with the work shape the new role owns
responsibilities: Read the card and its brief; the frozen acceptance is the contract.
Write or adopt the plan, then audit it against the acceptance.
Execute the smallest correct change and run the self-check.
Deliver at in_review with the commit anchor, the acceptance mapping and the evidence.
boundaries: Do not accept your own work or move a card to done.
Do not merge, rebase or push from the card.
Do not widen the scope; a scope expansion is an E1 question.
Do not create downstream or fix cards; the director's triage does.
